newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana unions seek minimum wage review.
newsitem.headline: Ghana unions seek minimum wage review.

text.p: Ghana's Trades Union Congress (TUC) has called for a review of the 1,700 cedi minimum daily wage to take account of a 17 percent fuel price increase.
A statement from the TUC said immediate action needed to be taken to avoid industrial disruption.

"To restore some measure of relevance of the current minimum wage to the cost of living situation, the TUC calls for an emergency meeting of the Tripartite Committee to review the current minimum wage of cedi 1,700 without delay," it said.
The commission groups government, employers' and workers' representatives.
Year-on-year inflation was about 35 percent at the end of 1996 compared to 70 percent a year earlier.
Beef costs 6,000 cedi/kg, rice up to 1,300 cedi/kg. Consulting a doctor costs between Cedi 5,000 and 25,000 cedis.
